data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'gar', which means 'spear' or 'javelin'. In Christian context, this name is associated with St. Giles, the patron saint of the disabled and those suffering from mental illness. The name Gar symbolizes strength, courage, and protection. The name Gar carries the meaning “Spear, Javelin” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gar usually hope their child will grow to embody spear, javelin and live with faith, good character and purpose.
